text: {"us_status":"written","label_product":"Gemcitabine Injection, for intravenous use — Hospira, Inc.","label_version_or_date":"DailyMed updated April 27, 2026; U.S. PI revised 5/2024; LAB-1030-4.0","label_section":"Warnings and Precautions, 5.3 Severe Cutaneous Adverse Reactions (SCARs)","quote":"SCARs, including Stevens-Johnson syndrome (SJS), toxic epidermal necrolysis (TEN), drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms (DRESS), and acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis (AGEP), which can be life-threatening or fatal, have been reported in association with gemcitabine treatment [see Adverse Reactions (6.2)]. Monitor patients for signs and symptoms of severe cutaneous adverse reactions. Permanently discontinue gemcitabine in patients who develop SCARs.","eu":"EU: PRAC signal EPITT 20256 adopted 11 June 2026 recommends adding DRESS to gemcitabine SmPC section 4.4 as a warning and section 4.8 as an undesirable effect with frequency not known.","uk":"UK: current UK SmPCs appear updated to include DRESS in sections 4.4 and 4.8; GOV.UK/MHRA had a September 2025 gemcitabine alert on serious skin reactions that did not yet list DRESS.","us_regulator":"FDA: yes—FAERS/AEMS potential-signals list for July–September 2023 listed Gemcitabine/Infugem for DRESS; FDA says gemcitabine labeling was updated May–September 2024 for SCARs.","sources":["https://www.dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=e18ed1cb-7dd0-4001-bfda-17d1f4587fb8","https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/prac-recommendation/prac-recommendations-signals-adopted-8-11-june-2026-prac-meeting_en.pdf","https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/minutes/minutes-prac-meeting-8-11-june-2026_en.pdf","https://www.gov.uk/drug-device-alerts/class-4-medicines-defect-notification-hikma-farmaceutica-gemcitabine-2g-slash-52-dot-6ml-concentrate-for-solution-for-infusion-el-25-a-slash-43","https://www.medicines.org.uk/emc/product/4483/smpc","https://www.fda.gov/drugs/fda-adverse-event-monitoring-system-aems/july-september-2023-potential-signals-serious-risksnew-safety-information-identified-fda-adverse"]}
